limitations: AdmissionStore remains unwired: no HTTP/socket route, room/travel/lifecycle hook, polling scheduler, native bridge or operator cap change. hard/target default0 and paused; no current gameplay or release behavior is activated.

Single actual RoomAuthority and its stable lifetime epoch are trusted inputs. Multiple adapters must share that epoch; this is not multi-owner distributed fencing. Recovery may remove obsolete occupied rows only after the previous in-memory room owner ended; identity sessions and waiting tickets remain.

ACTIVE does not expire by wall clock. Expired rows beyond the bounded janitor batch remain conservatively counted; failed transactions roll cleanup back. A future trusted scheduler must retain these bounds.

Receipt replay returns current own state, never a stale authorization. Seven-day retention can turn an old enqueue into a fresh WAITING ticket; it cannot resurrect an old ACTIVE lease. Queue ceilings/test caps are not production CCU or authorization to raise capacity.

Future route/native integration must add and qualify transport Origin/CSRF/native-ticket binding, complete safety/consent checks, privacy-export registration and authoritative room/travel release hooks before enabling admission. Existing account deletion cascades entries/receipts and its lock order is retained.
